name: Jordan Hale
headline: Product designer who turns messy problems into things people love using.
about: I've spent eight years designing apps people use every day, from a banking app with 2 million customers to a two-person startup's first release. I like sitting with users, sketching fast and shipping something real by Friday. Outside work I throw pots and lose at trivia.

experience.summary: Lead designer on the everyday banking app.
highlights: Redesigned onboarding, lifting completed sign-ups by 34%.
Built the design system now used by 6 product teams.
Ran 40+ user interviews a year and shared every one.
